asset_type.description: Discriminator identifying this as a text asset. See /schemas/creative/asset-types for the registry.

language.description: Optional language claim for this text. In a materialized creative localization variant, localized-creative-asset.json requires this value to use /schemas/core/locale-tag.json and conformance requires exact equality with the enclosing variant locale. General non-localized assets retain the legacy unconstrained string for compatibility.

provenance.description: Provenance metadata for this asset, overrides manifest-level provenance
